page_title: MAI 0-1 FRE | Mainz v Freiburg 12/04/2026, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+8' That's it for today, Felix Zwayer has blown his whistle and the game is over.
90+3' Freiburg work the corner short. The ball is passed to a nearby teammate.
90+3' Vincenzo Grifo (Freiburg) slaloms his way past challenges, but an opposing player does well to get the ball away. Freiburg have been awarded a corner kick.
90+2' Armindo Sieb (Mainz) pounces on the cross into the centre of the box, but hangs his head in shame after sending his header well wide of the left post when the keeper was on his backside.
90+2' Anthony Caci (Mainz) attempts to send over a cross in order to find one of his teammates, but an opposition defender averts the danger by intercepting the effort.
90+1' Anthony Caci (Mainz) produces a quality cross into the box, but the opposition's defence intercepts the ball and spanks it away.
90' The fourth official shows 5 min. of added time.
86' Phillip Tietz (Mainz) serves up a nice cross, but Noah Atubolu punches the ball away.
83' Urs Fischer prepares a substitution. Danny da Costa is replaced by Nelson Weiper (Mainz).
83' Matthias Ginter (Freiburg) is substituted due to injury. Julian Schuster gives a chance to Jordy Makengo.
81' Sheraldo Becker (Mainz) is first to react to a loose pass inside the box, but slices his shot just wide of the right post.
80' Nadiem Amiri (Mainz) takes the resulting corner which is well defended.
80' The resulting set piece, sent into the penalty area by Nadiem Amiri (Mainz), was easily dealt with by one of the defenders. The ball is out of play and Mainz manage to earn a corner.

79' Silvan Widmer (Mainz) receives a precise pass and is given time inside the box to send a promising strike towards the middle of the goal. Noah Atubolu guesses his intention and denies him with a fine save.
77' An attempted cross from Nadiem Amiri (Mainz) is cleared.
77' The attendance is 30000.
74' Here comes a substitution. Armindo Sieb (Mainz) is brought on as a substitute for Paul Nebel.
74' Urs Fischer has decided to make a change. Anthony Caci (Mainz) replaces Phillipp Mwene.
74' Substitution. Derry Scherhant leaves the pitch and is replaced by Vincenzo Grifo (Freiburg).
73' Lucas Holer (Freiburg) receives a yellow card for a nasty tackle.
70' What a miss! A floated cross from the flank picks out Silvan Widmer (Mainz) unmarked near the penalty spot with just the keeper to beat, but he skies his header miles over the bar.
69' Mainz take a short corner instead of sending the ball into the penalty area.
69' Phillipp Mwene (Mainz) crosses the ball into the box, but one of the defending players averts the threat.
67' Phillipp Mwene (Mainz) sends a pass into the penalty area, but the opponent manages to cut it out.
64' The substitution has been made. Philipp Treu (Freiburg) has replaced Lukas Kubler.
64' Julian Schuster has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Jan-Niklas Beste (Freiburg) replacing Cyriaque Irie.

64' Stefan Posch (Mainz) comes close to scoring! He gets the ball inside the box from the resulting corner but his effort goes narrowly wide of the left post. This should be a big warning for the defence.
64' Nadiem Amiri (Mainz) takes the ball to the corner flag and sends it into the box.
63' Silvan Widmer (Mainz) whips the ball into the penalty area, but one of the defenders is alert and spanks it away. The ball goes out of play. Mainz are awarded a corner kick.
62' Urs Fischer has decided to substitute Nikolas Veratschnig and he is replaced by Silvan Widmer (Mainz).
62' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Nadiem Amiri (Mainz) will replace Sota Kawasaki.
62' Derry Scherhant (Freiburg) swings in the corner, but it's comfortably cleared away.
61' The corner from Derry Scherhant (Freiburg) is hurriedly cleared. The referee points to the corner flag. It's a corner to Freiburg.

60' Johan Manzambi (Freiburg) latches on to a perfectly taken corner kick deep into the box and attempts to head home. His bullet header heads straight towards the roof of the net, but it's deflected onto the crossbar by the goalkeeper. A wonderful effort.
60' Derry Scherhant (Freiburg) looks like he will be the one to take the corner kick.
60' Johan Manzambi (Freiburg) shoots from the edge of the penalty area. The ball travels towards the crossbar, but Daniel Batz easily deals with the threat.
58' Lucas Holer (Freiburg) delivers a long ball, but it lacks enough power to reach his teammates and is intercepted by one of the defenders.
55' The game is interrupted. Nikolas Veratschnig (Mainz) is given a yellow card. He has to be more careful now.
54' Felix Zwayer blows his whistle and signals a foul after Cyriaque Irie (Freiburg) brought his opponent down.

52' Sheraldo Becker (Mainz) wasted a huge opportunity! The fans already began to celebrate as he produced a low shot from the edge of the box after a brilliant solo effort. The ball went towards the middle of the goal, but Noah Atubolu made an astonishing save!
51' A neat pass is well received by Phillip Tietz (Mainz), who is lurking on the edge of the box and strikes the ball on goal. The goalkeeper makes a decent save to block his shot.

47' 0 - 1 Lucas Holer (Freiburg) gets to the ball inside the penalty area and produces a bullet header towards the goal. He aims his effort nicely into the top right corner, leaving Daniel Batz helpless. He makes it 0:1.
46' Julian Schuster has made a change at the break. Philipp Lienhart has come on in place of Bruno Ogbus (Freiburg).
46' The whistle blows and Felix Zwayer starts the second half.
45+4' Julian Schuster isn't happy on the touchline after referee Felix Zwayer shows him a yellow card.
45+4' Maximilian Eggestein (Freiburg) attempts to discuss the decision with Felix Zwayer, but he soon realises that it's not the right thing to do as he sees the yellow.
45+4' The match has reached half-time.
45+2' Phillip Tietz (Mainz) times his run too early and the linesman raises his flag for offside.
45' 3 additional min. will be played.
45' Igor Matanovic (Freiburg) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge.
43' Phillip Tietz (Mainz) slides a pass forward, but one of the defenders cuts it out.
42' Dangerous play by Lukas Kubler (Freiburg). Felix Zwayer blows his whistle for a foul. There is a free kick near the sideline to Mainz.
40' The current number of shots on goal is 1:0.
37' Igor Matanovic (Freiburg) handles the ball inside the penalty area.
36' Stefan Posch (Mainz) finds some space to control the ball from the corner and shoots, but his attempt goes way wide of the right post.
36' Paul Nebel (Mainz) steps up to send the ball in.
35' Paul Nebel (Mainz) takes the corner but fails to find any of his teammates. Good work from Mainz as they win a corner.
33' Felix Zwayer shows a yellow card to Bruno Ogbus (Freiburg) for his blatant foul.
30' The game is interrupted as Lukas Kubler (Freiburg) is flagged offside.

26' Stefan Posch (Mainz) received a fine pass and tried his luck from long range. His attempt went towards the left side of the goal, but Noah Atubolu pulled off a great save to push the ball onto the post.
24' Phillipp Mwene (Mainz) finds himself beyond the last defender, but the game is stopped by the referee after the linesman signals for offside.
22' Danny da Costa (Mainz) picks up the ball inside the penalty box and immediately fires a first-time effort that sails well over the crossbar and ends in the stands.
21' Matthias Ginter (Freiburg) is lying on the ground after being tackled and the physio comes onto the pitch to give him medical treatment.
19' Sheraldo Becker (Mainz) is unable to feed an accurate cross into the box.
15' Paul Nebel (Mainz) takes the corner which is cleared.

15' Sheraldo Becker (Mainz) dinks a cross into the box in an attempt to find one of his teammates, but the defence manages to clear. The ball goes out of play and Mainz have been awarded a corner kick.
14' Igor Matanovic (Freiburg) misses a promising opportunity! He rises for a cross and unleashes a poor header from near the penalty spot. The ball floats high over the crossbar!
13' Nikolas Veratschnig (Mainz) escapes without any punishment from the referee after using excessive force to foul his opponent.
10' Derry Scherhant (Freiburg) flights in the cross, but the defender is alert and clears to safety.
7' Derry Scherhant (Freiburg) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him.
5' Nikolas Veratschnig (Mainz) does his best to latch onto a cross into the box, but he can't get to the ball.
3' The linesman raises his flag for offside before Cyriaque Irie (Freiburg) heads on.
2' Cyriaque Irie (Freiburg) sends a teasing cross into the area, but Daniel Batz intercepts the ball.
1' The first half has started.
The players are on the pitch and Mainz will have the kick-off.
Felix Zwayer got the nomination for today's game and will try his best to be a fair judge and not make any mistakes.
